@MattyAnd @nkolekar-nk

I have received, authenticated and privately reviewed Nisha's corrected restricted v2 parameter/destination record, revision 2.

**Accepted record SHA-256:**
`adf4a975f14dad407a56e3b3517a181d8cfcfd9c918894b63d5e7ec6292c1dfc`

I confirm the accepted v2 selector pins, complete 168-date candidate pool, explicit v2 nonce-derivation rules and separate domains, root constraints, fail-stop rules, conditions A/B and legacy-or-CF60 forecast restriction.

I also accept the revised custody arrangement: the nonce and associated restricted records are stored separately from the selector destination, which contains only `metadata.json` and `complete.sha256`. Independent checksum custody remains required.

This comment is my approval and decision locator for the exact revision 2 parameter/custody record. It supersedes the unaccepted original record.

Nisha may proceed with the agreed private nonce creation, selection, isolation checks and independent receiving under the accepted protocol.

This approval does not authorize source ingestion, model execution, scientific freeze or any subsequent study run. Source-use/provenance requirements remain separate and unresolved.
